en.title: Apple Vision Pro Adds Accessibility Features Amid Taipei Wheelchair Accessibility Review
en.summary: Apple Vision Pro will receive three new accessibility features, including vehicle motion cues, face gestures, and dwell control, aimed at improving usability for users with disabilities. In Taipei, a wheelchair tour highlighted discontinuities in the city's barrier‑free road infrastructure. Meanwhile, Hsinchu City bus drivers practiced wheelchair use to better understand accessibility needs and handle harassment incidents.

highlights.title: Three More Accessibility Features Are Coming to Apple Vision Pro

zh-TW.title: Apple Vision Pro 加入三項無障礙功能，台北輪椅揭露道路斷裂
zh-TW.summary: Apple Vision Pro 將加入車輛運動提示、面部手勢和停留控制三項無障礙功能，以提升殘障使用者體驗。台北輪椅體驗揭露無障礙道路斷裂，呼籲改善。竹市公車駕駛透過坐輪椅體驗，演練無障礙服務與性騷擾處理。
